competitors.what_they_do: WhatsApp e-commerce enablement and automated catalogue storefronts for Indian merchants.

funding.text: raised $10.8 million in Series A funding led by Sequoia Capital India

competitors.evidence_quote: Bikayi enables merchants to set up digital storefronts on WhatsApp with payments integration

competitors.name: Wati

funding.text: secured $23M Series B led by Tiger Global

competitors.evidence_quote: Wati provides CRM and automated sales bots for SMEs via the WhatsApp API

competitors.name: QuickSell
competitors.what_they_do: Mobile commerce and digital catalogue app with WhatsApp sharing and analytics.
competitors.evidence_quote: QuickSell helps wholesalers and retailers showcase catalogues and receive orders on WhatsApp

tam_evidence.quote: Indian conversational commerce market projected to reach ₹1,200 crore by 2026

tam_note: Deck claim of ₹500 crore is conservative relative to Entrackr's ₹1,200 crore estimate.

assumptions: TAM based on 63M Indian MSMEs with 10% smartphone sales penetration
